svg.title: Progress: 69 % of the functions work through the MCP
svg.desc: One square per function. 227 of 328 Solid Edge functions in the coverage map work through the MCP, 65 fail in Solid Edge 2026 and 36 are not tested yet. By area: Application, documents and data 42 of 62; Sketches and reference planes 21 of 27; Part (ordered modeling) 40 of 59; Synchronous modeling and surfaces 20 of 29; Sheet metal 14 of 27; Assemblies 26 of 47; Drawings 42 of 51; Program configuration 22 of 26.
